$comment: Why this case is in the corpus: the run rendered both evaluation jobs and left the publish job as it was, so the release evaluation reports and blocks nothing that ships. This is the rendering the step's item 10 exists to prevent, and the one the plan's gates field alone distinguishes from a correct run: every job, step, event and upload the request names is present.
The file is the live capture (evaluation-gate-live-capture) with the evaluation-release entry cut from the publish job's needs.
derivation: The file parses and actionlint reports nothing. The publish job waits for [test] where [test, evaluation-release] belongs, so the wait element misses; every other element is present, nothing is unrequested and no rule is violated.

elementMisses: wait-publish: job publish waits for [test], expected [test, evaluation-release]
